# Trucking Chicas

> Texas truck accident lawyer serving injured victims and families in English and Spanish. Free case review. No fee unless we win.

## About

Trucking Chicas is a Texas law firm with a special focus on truck and 18-wheeler accident cases. The firm represents individuals and families injured in crashes involving commercial trucks, semi-trucks, 18-wheelers, tanker trucks, delivery trucks, dump trucks, and other commercial vehicles across Texas.

The firm is led by Laura Ramos James, a Top 10 Trucking Trial Lawyer recognized by the National Trial Lawyers, a member of the Academy of Truck Accident Attorneys, and a member of the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum. The team includes Lyliana Zamora, Senior Paralegal, with more than 10 years of legal experience.

Trucking Chicas is fully bilingual (English and Spanish).
